verdict.rationale: Viam documents a broad public API surface for programmatic control. The machine API connects to a machine, retrieves status and sends commands; the fleet management API manages orgs, locations, machines and permissions "with code the same way you can do in the web UI"; an ML Training Client API is also listed. These are reachable through SDKs in Python, Go, C++, TypeScript and Flutter, and through a CLI that calls any API method with JSON in and JSON out, with a dedicated guide for driving machines from an AI agent. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404 on all candidate paths) and no independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven API use.
